scenario_enrichment.summary: Added source-safe scenario separating SPP 202 construction-phase design administration, SPP 204-A full-time supervision, SPP 204-B construction management, and contractor responsibility under UAP Document 301.
scenario_enrichment.scenario_excerpt: A building owner asks the architect to add daily site presence to a regular design-service proposal. A source-safe answer first names the base SPP 202 construction phase, then checks whether the owner is actually asking for full-time supervision under SPP 204-A or broader construction management under SPP 204-B. If the owner stations project representatives, resident architects, resident engineers, or construction inspectors on site, UAP Document 301 keeps them as assistants to the architect and engineers; it does not transfer the contractor's duty to perform the work according to the drawings, specifications, and other Contract Documents.
